task: add rate limiting to the public search endpoint

roles.name: search-endpoint-rate-limiter
roles.mission: add a token bucket rate limiter to the public search endpoint
acceptance: unauthenticated callers are limited to 30 requests per minute per IP
a limited caller gets HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header

roles.name: rate-limiter-behavior-checker
roles.mission: verify the search endpoint rate limiter behaves per the criteria
criteria: unauthenticated callers are limited to 30 requests per minute per IP
a limited caller gets HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header
